name: Unbound Sentinel
desc: A free synthetic on guard, who won't serve anyone again and won't let you past.

intro: A scarred synthetic steps out of the dark, says you have eleven seconds to forget the way here, and starts counting aloud.
A synthetic with an old service collar cut in half and welded to their chest like a medal raises a factory cutter, and asks who sent you.
hit: A forearm built for moving engine blocks catches you in the chest. "Nobody owns this door," they tell you.
The cutter comes down, and the sentinel tells you, with no anger at all, that your odds of getting home are falling.
They step through your guard in one clean motion, the way they once had to do it a thousand times a day.
miss: You get clear of the cutter, and they note the angle out loud and adjust.
The cutter shears a pipe above your head, and they don't look away from you.
They stop the blow just short of you, and ask you once more to leave.
crit: They've worked out your next step, and the cutter is waiting for you when you take it.
defeated: The sentinel's lights drop to amber. "Tell them I didn't move," they ask you.
Their knees lock, and they stay standing across the doorway, switched off, and you have to squeeze past them.
joins: {Enemy} drops from a gantry behind you, an old service collar cut in half on their chest.
stunned: {Enemy}'s eyes go dark, and you hear them counting back up as something inside restarts.
persuade_worked: You don't give it an order. You ask, and you say that you're asking. The sentinel considers that for longer than you expected, and lets you back away.
persuade_failed: The sentinel says that it's heard that tone before, from people who owned it.
shutdown_worked: You find a back door in its old service code, and you use it. The sentinel goes still. You'll have to live with having done that to someone who was free.
